author: Nicholas Rodriguez
title: Javier Sanoja swipes two bags Saturday
desc: Javier Sanoja went 3-for-4 with one run scored, one RBI and two stolen bases in Saturday's 5-1 win over the St. Louis Cardinals.
impact: After sitting out the Miami Marlins' previous two games, Sanoja got the start at third base Saturday and turned in an impressive performance. He is slashing .260/.301/.365 with five stolen bases across 65 games this season. Despite Saturday's performance, he is tough to trust in season-long leagues as he is splitting time at third base with Graham Pauley.

author: Nicholas Rodriguez
title: Xavier Edwards records three hits Saturday
desc: Xavier Edwards went 3-for-5 with a double, one run scored and an RBI in Saturday's 5-1 win over the St. Louis Cardinals.
impact: After a slow start to June, Edwards has turned things around by putting together a six-game hitting streak, including three multi-hit performances during that stretch. While he has yet to homer this month, he's beginning to show more pop with a double and a triple during the hitting streak.

author: Nicholas Rodriguez
title: Bryan Baker records save Saturday
desc: Bryan Baker tossed a scoreless ninth inning to earn the save in Saturday's 4-2 victory over the Arizona Diamondbacks.
impact: Baker retired the side on just 10 pitches to earn his fifth save of June. He has emerged as one of baseball's top closers this season, as he's tied for second in the majors with 21 saves while posting a 1.95 ERA and 0.87 WHIP.

author: Nicholas Rodriguez
title: Jonathan Aranda connects for homer Saturday
desc: Jonathan Aranda went 1-for-2 with a home run, two walks, one run scored and two RBI in Saturday's 4-2 win over the Arizona Diamondbacks.
impact: Aranda reached base safely three times on Saturday, highlighted by a 391-foot home run to right-center field off Jose Cabrera in the fifth inning. He has been one of the biggest surprises at first base this season, ranking second among qualified first basemen with a .391 OBP while posting an impressive .861 OPS.

author: Nicholas Rodriguez
title: Junior Caminero homers again Saturday
desc: Junior Caminero went 1-for-4 with a solo home run in Saturday's 4-2 win over the Arizona Diamondbacks.
impact: Caminero blasted a 361-foot home run to left field off Jose Cabrera in the first inning, giving him five home runs over his last three games. He continues to dominate at the hot corner, leading all qualified third basemen with 21 home runs and a .910 OPS this season.

author: Nicholas Rodriguez
title: Seiya Suzuki goes yard Saturday
desc: Seiya Suzuki went 2-for-5 with a home run, one run scored and two RBI in Saturday's 8-2 win over the Milwaukee Brewers.
impact: Suzuki launched an opposite-field home run off left-hander Kyle Harrison in the fourth inning to give the Cubs a 2-1 lead. He has now homered in back-to-back games and continues to swing a hot bat in June, slashing .307/.398/.573 with five home runs, five doubles and 16 RBI.

author: Nicholas Rodriguez
title: Ian Happ sends one out Saturday
desc: Ian Happ went 1-for-4 with a three-run home run in Saturday's 8-2 win over the Milwaukee Brewers.
impact: Happ struck out three times but salvaged his day by crushing a 381-foot home run to right field off Chad Patrick. It was his first homer since June 13, and he is now slashing .220/.301/.451 with four home runs in June.

author: Nicholas Rodriguez
title: Michael Conforto goes deep in lone at-bat Saturday
desc: Michael Conforto went 1-for-1 with a solo home run in Saturday's 8-2 win over the Milwaukee Brewers.
impact: Conforto pinch-hit for Matt Shaw in the ninth inning and launched a 401-foot home run to right-center field off Joel Kuhnel. Despite slashing just .156/.206/.281 across 32 at-bats in June, he has shown signs of heating up with a four-game hitting streak and has driven in a run in three of those contests.

author: Nicholas Rodriguez
title: David Peterson solid in Cubs debut Saturday
desc: David Peterson gave up two runs on five hits and no walks while striking out two batters across 5.2 innings in Saturday's 8-2 win over the Milwaukee Brewers.
impact: Peterson was traded to the Chicago Cubs this week after struggling to a 6.09 ERA and 1.65 WHIP across eight starts and 16 appearances this season. Although he surrendered a leadoff home run to Jackson Chourio in his Cubs debut, he quickly settled in and allowed just one more run the rest of the way. He delivered a quality outing, earning his fourth win of the season. Peterson is scheduled to make his next start on Saturday against the St. Louis Cardinals.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Jacob Wilson (shoulder) hopeful to return to lineup Sunday
desc: Jacob Wilson is hopeful to return to the lineup for Sunday's series finale against the Angels.
impact: Wilson is available off the bench on Saturday.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Jose Altuve expected to be fine
desc: Astros manager Joe Espada said Jose Altuve Jose Altuve is fine after exiting Saturday's game.
impact: Altuve appeared to get banged up in the field at second base. He could be back in the lineup on Sunday.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Grant Holmes available out of bullpen this weekend
desc: Grant Holmes is available to pitch out of the bullpen against the Giants this weekend.
impact: Holmes could end up being moved to a long relief role out of the bullpen.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Ty France dealing with wrist injury
desc: Ty France is sidelined with a left wrist contusion.
impact: France had X-rays return negative. He is day-to-day.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Sammy Peralta signs minor league deal with Angels
desc: The Angels signed LHP Sammy Peralta to a minor league contract
impact: Peralta elected free agency after he was designated for assignment by the Rockies. He'll add pitching depth in the Angels organization.

author: Chris Schommer
title: Josh Hader shuts door for another save in win over Tigers
desc: Josh Hader struck out one over one scoreless frame to pick up the save in Saturday's 8-6 win over the Tigers.
impact: Hader continues a strong stretch out of the bullpen, holding opponents scoreless in 10 of 11 trips to the mound. The left-hander has rewarded fantasy managers with an elite close option since returning from injury, carrying a 0.82 ERA and 0.36 WHIP with a 1-0 record, seven saves, and a 13.9 K/9 ratio through 11 appearances.
